version: v1 (14 Nov 2026), drafted by the lead, NOT yet checked by a Tamil reader
what: Spoken-form, Tamil-script references for the 41 paired benchmark prompts. The written prompts hold Latin script and digits that no Tamil ASR writes back, so CER against them is only good for paired comparison. Each prompt has one or more acceptable readings (numbers read in Tamil or in English); a hypothesis is scored against the closest one. Transliteration spelling is not standard in Tamil, so an absolute CER on these still carries spelling noise that is the same for every system.
